independent_reference.source: Analytic state-sensitivity of the ideal simple pendulum: the gravity-only point-mass EOM is q_ddot = -(g/L) sin q (I_com=0, pivot inertia mL^2), so d q_ddot/d q = -(g/L) cos q, closed-form. The wp.Tape adjoint through the landed Featherstone ABA kernel matches this to machine precision for the single pendulum (Stage-0 WARP-NATIVE-TAPE probe: relerr <= 1.9e-16). Source: rigid-body EOM / Featherstone (2008), Rigid Body Dynamics Algorithms, Ch. 7 sec 7.3 (simple-pendulum gravity-only limit, independent of the recursion). Hand-derived.

Central finite-difference baseline d q_ddot/d q ~ (q_ddot(q+eps) - q_ddot(q-eps))/(2 eps), eps=1e-6, O(eps^2). An independent numerical method (parameter perturbation of the forward ABA) cross-checking the wp.Tape autodiff engine; close-R2 numerical-baseline exemption.

Analytic torque-sensitivity d q_ddot/d tau = H^-1 = 1/(I_com + m cdist^2) = 1/(mL^2) for the single link (joint-space inertia inversion / parallel-axis), closed-form and configuration-independent. Distinct physical term (torque- not state-sensitivity), parameter (tau not q), and method (inertia inversion not gravity linearization). Source: Featherstone (2008) ABA single-link inertia. Hand-derived.
